subject.title: marketplace-crons: Fnac devuelve 500 en pedidos y batch

question: Should Fnac `DELETE OFFER` 500s remain treated as transient provider noise, or should the team implement delete-offer-specific recovery despite `/offers_update` being side-effectful?
rationale: Current source shows the code path clearly, but choosing retry/recovery semantics for Fnac offer deletion can change marketplace side effects and needs operational ownership.

options.title: Keep canonical open and re-check production recurrence
options.body: Use the newer withdraw logs plus BigQuery to confirm whether the recurrence is sustained before changing side-effectful Fnac behavior.

options.title: Implement scoped safe retries only
options.body: Add retry/backoff only for idempotent or low-side-effect paths such as auth, orders query, and batch status, while separately designing delete-offer handling.

options.title: Accept provider noise and close after evidence
options.body: Close only if a fresh production window shows no sustained recurrence and the existing next-cron recovery is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical open and re-check production recurrence
recommendation.body: Use the newer withdraw logs plus BigQuery to confirm whether the recurrence is sustained before changing side-effectful Fnac behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn is the strongest current code-history owner for the affected Fnac and withdraw paths and applied the latest related logging changes.
